Subject: Trial Sprint Charter & Kickoff — Alder Health (POC)

Hi Erin / Tom,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today — great context on your clinical-note extraction use case. Per our discussion I drafted a concise sprint charter and a suggested timeline so we can get the POC moving quickly. Attached: poc-charter.xlsx (high level success criteria, roles, milestones) and network-diagram.png (inbound/outbound flow for VPC option).

Top-line proposal (feel free to edit):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for structured extraction across 3 clinical note templates with >90% entity F1 on the evaluation set and <=200ms 95th-percentile latency for 512-token requests.
- Timeline: 4 weeks (kickoff, dataset ingest & config, weekly check-ins, final readout).
- Weekly cadence: 30-min syncs on Wednesdays, readout in week 4 with artifact deliverables.
- Owners: Alder: Erin (product lead), Tom (security/ops). Redwood: Chloe (customer lead), Marissa (solutions), Jonas (SRE).

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm the three note templates you want included and point me to a sample set (S3 link or secure transfer)?
2) Are you able to run a short firewall rule change for the pilot (we included details in the network diagram) or do you prefer the VPC appliance route?
3) Preferred kickoff window next week (we have Tue/Thu mornings PT open).

If that looks good I'll update the charter with final owners and spin up a provisional project in HubSpot + shared Drive folder.

Thanks — hope to lock kickoff this week.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Chloe — thanks for the recap and the attachments, that's exactly the level of detail we needed. Quick answers inline and a couple of asks:

- Note templates: I'll upload three anonymized samples to the Drive link you shared by tomorrow (one outpatient note, one discharge summary, one consult).
- Firewall / network: We prefer not to open inbound rules. Procurement asked whether Redwood supports a VPC/private deployment for the pilot — can you confirm technical fit? If not, we can do temporary CIDR allowlist for the trial window but will need a more secure path for production.
- Success criterion tweak: Our clinical team wants entity-level recall >92% for medication and dosage extraction (we can accept slightly lower for free-text notes). Can you add that to the charter?

Kickoff: Thu, 22 Apr, 9:00 — works for Erin/Tom (we're PT). If you can do that we'll plan internal alignment next Mon.

Also looping in Procurement for SOW and procurement timeline questions.

Thanks — Erin
Erin Walsh
